name: 撑“杆”跳跃
description: 传送至地格（5），对相邻地格内所有敌人造成3点伤害，然后移速+1。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var targetPosition = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 5, filter: 'all' }); if (!targetPosition || targetPosition.needsTargetSelection) return targetPosition; var tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(item) { return item.x === targetPosition.x && item.y === targetPosition.y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props || !tile.props.walkable) return { success: false, message: '目标地格不可行走' }; var occupied = battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.instanceId !== source.instanceId && piece.x === targetPosition.x && piece.y === targetPosition.y; }); if (occupied) return { success: false, message: '目标地格已有棋子' }; if (!flow.effects.displace([{ pieceId: source.instanceId, x: targetPosition.x, y: targetPosition.y }], 'teleport').success) return { success: true, message: '位移被阻挡，本次位移效果取消' }; var enemies = battle.pieces.filter(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && !arePlayersAllied(battle, piece.ownerPlayerId, source.ownerPlayerId) && Math.abs(piece.x - source.x) <= 1 && Math.abs(piece.y - source.y) <= 1; }); if (enemies.length) dealDamage(source, enemies, 3, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); source.moveRange = (source.moveRange || 0) + 1; return { success: true, message: source.name + '跳跃至(' + targetPosition.x + ',' + targetPosition.y + ')并对周围敌人造成3点伤害，移速+1' }; }
